messages:
marta (sec-lead): quick sync - we've got a focused pen test 2026-04-02. Scope: read-only evidence retrieval, KMS decrypt for packaged artifacts, full object-level audit trail. Planning a 30m dry-run 4/1 10:00 PT. Need RBAC + KMS plan. @pranav @tess

pranav (infra): suggest ephemeral role in our account with trust to vendor principals, max session 1h. Policy: s3:GetObject/ListBucket on redwood-pt-evidence, logs:FilterLogEvents, kms:Decrypt on single key. Add explicit Deny for /models/* and /generated/* prefixes.

Tess (eng-sre): agree. Will also enable S3 server access logs + CloudTrail data events for the bucket, forward to locked audit archive.

marta (sec-lead): legal constraint: no plaintext or key material sharing. KMS must be via Grants scoped to role and require encryptionContext e.g. {"evidence-origin":"redteamco"}. Decrypt audit retention >=90d.

pranav (infra): I'll create KMS Grant in staging and a CFN snippet for the role. Grant will include EncryptionContext restriction; I'll record grant id and automation to revoke after engagement. Staging ready by 3/30 EOD.

jon (platform): set CloudWatch Logs retention to 365d for the pt log groups. Also enable CloudTrail data events to capture object GETs and send to archive with MFA-delete.

Tess (eng-sre): posting pre-dry-run checklist in ~2h. Will validate assume-role, S3 reads logged, KMS decrypt event appears in CloudTrail, and that restricted prefixes are inaccessible.

marta (sec-lead): action items: 1) pr anav - role + grant staging (due 3/30) 2) tess - checklist & runbook (due 3/31) 3) jon - enable data events & logs (due 3/31) 4) marta - upload vendor principals list (today). Scheduling retest 1h week of 4/15 after remediation.

audit-bot: automated note - CloudTrail data events will be enabled for arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence; retention configured to 395 days.
